entities.title: Rust library (utv 0.3.0)
entities.summary: The Rust implementation of UTV: one Cargo package, utv, with the JSON layer and the typed layer, its tests and its two example suites.
entities.purpose: Holds the crate utv (Cargo.toml, edition 2021): the library in src/, its integration tests and example suites in tests/, and its README and CHANGELOG. It reads and writes utv/1.0, answers utv-result/1.0 and reads and writes the text form utv-text/1, without reading the clock, the host's zone or locale.
boundaries: The specification, the structural schema and the conformance material belong to spec/, schema/ and conformance/; the crate compiles the schema in and the tests read the fixtures in place, never copies.
There are no example programs: the examples are the unit tests in tests/utv_first and tests/native_first.
The CHANGELOG is the record of the crate's versions.
